content:
Standardpharm Co., Ltd. is a prominent chemical company headquartered at 363 East 42nd Street, New York, NY 10017, strategically located in the heart of Manhattan’s bustling business district. Though its address places it within one of the world’s most dynamic commercial environments, Standardpharm operates as a specialized entity at the intersection of the pharmaceutical and chemical industries, focusing on the research, development, and distribution of high-purity chemical compounds essential for pharmaceutical manufacturing, biomedical research, and industrial applications. With a commitment to quality, innovation, and regulatory compliance, the company has established itself as a trusted partner for laboratories, healthcare providers, and pharmaceutical firms across the United States and globally.

Standardpharm Co., Ltd. prides itself on maintaining strict adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), ISO standards, and FDA guidelines, ensuring that all products meet the highest benchmarks for safety, efficacy, and consistency. Its product portfolio encompasses a wide array of specialty chemicals, including active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates, and custom-synthesized compounds tailored to meet client specifications. Beyond product supply, the company offers comprehensive technical support, regulatory consulting, and supply chain solutions designed to streamline operations for its partners.

Despite its New York address, Standardpharm operates with a global outlook, leveraging advanced R&D capabilities and a network of international collaborations to drive innovation in chemical synthesis and drug development. With a mission to advance health and scientific progress through chemistry, Standardpharm Co., Ltd. continues to position itself as a forward-thinking leader in the life sciences sector.
